It is a small world... by Pan American
AMERICA'S MERCHANT MARINE OF THE AIR
map with the total network regularly flown by Pan American Clippers today
...65,000 miles of skyways joining fifty-five countries and colonies!
Think what this change signifies. It means a world shrunk to one-sixth its
former size by the magic of air transportation. It means that those great silver
shuttles, the Flying Clipper Ships, are weaving a new fabric of friendly re-
lations with once-distant peoples who are now our neighbors.
It means a new American leadership in this changing world! Those Flying
Clipper Ships are America's Merchant Marine of the Air. They are recapturing,
on international trade routes, a prestige that has been lost to this country
since the days or sall.
Yankee enterprise has had to struggle against big odds. In the face of
keen foreign-flag competition there were complex franchises to be negoti-
ated, routes to be blazed, new-type planes to be developed. There were men
to be trained, radio and weather stations to be established, desert islands to
be colonized for air bases. Mile by mile the routes of the Clippers were
advanced through the Latin Americas... then across the Pacific, over the
Atlantic, up to Alaska, down to Australasia. The story isn't ended. Yet today-
Pan American speeds passengers, merchandise and mail between nearly
250 points, makes connections with other transportation lines to hundreds
more. Pan American planes have flown 1,400,000 persons 525,000,000 miles.
More than 2,300,000 tons of express cargo and mails have been carried! A
fleet of 130 Clippers maintains schedules at better than 98% regularity.
Wherever you live in America, a Pan American terminal city is quickly
accessible. You can get passenger details at any travel bureau or transportation
line office; express information at any Railway Express office; air mail data
at any post office... and all three at any Pan American office.
Whether you want to see fascinating lands, reach new markets with sales-
men and merchandise, or give wings to your letters, the Flying Clippers are
ready. They have shortened travel weeks to days, and days to
hours. Truly, it is a small world today ... by Pan American.
